title: Inspired Reading - Homeward Practice

blocks.label: Text: Lectio Divina - letting Scripture become encounter.
blocks.value: Lectio Divina - letting Scripture become encounter.

blocks.label: Text: Set aside seven to twenty quiet minutes. Read Matthew 7:24-27 in a trans…
blocks.value: Set aside seven to twenty quiet minutes. Read Matthew 7:24-27 in a translation you trust. Jesus' image of building on rock is not a demand for airtight certainty. It is an invitation to hear his words and practice his way.

blocks.label: Text: Place your feet on the floor. Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow b…
blocks.value: Place your feet on the floor. Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow breath.

blocks.label: Text: Read the passage slowly, twice. Notice one word or phrase that catches y…
blocks.value: Read the passage slowly, twice. Notice one word or phrase that catches your attention. Do not choose the most impressive phrase; receive the one that comes.

blocks.label: Text: Where does this phrase meet your actual life? What feels encouraging, un…
blocks.value: Where does this phrase meet your actual life? What feels encouraging, uncomfortable, resistant, or alive?

blocks.label: Text: Speak honestly with God. You might offer a question, a desire, a protest…
blocks.value: Speak honestly with God. You might offer a question, a desire, a protest, gratitude, or a request for help.

blocks.label: Text: Sit in silence for one minute. Then name one small way you can practice …
blocks.value: Sit in silence for one minute. Then name one small way you can practice what you heard.

blocks.label: Heading: Try the same passage for seven days.
blocks.value: Try the same passage for seven days.

blocks.label: Text: Notice how its invitation changes as you practice it rather than merely …
blocks.value: Notice how its invitation changes as you practice it rather than merely study it.
